description: Call this when the user asks what new perpetuals were listed, which exchange listed a coin first, or about delistings. Returns listings and delistings across every exchange the hourly scan covers. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

days.description: Window in days, 1-30 (default 30). Longer listing history is the listings dataset at bykaranteli.com/data.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

name: get_new_listings
title: New and delisted perpetual contracts
